1.name: Loyalty
1.text: {asterisk}Worth 25{fame} if there is no enemy in your kingdom.
1.helpText:
VERSION NOTE: This previously gave 35 fame.
Note that not all negative cards are enemies. All enemies always have a red background color behind their names, so all enemies are negative, but not all negative cards are enemies. Enemy is a keyword.
NOTE: Goals have the yellow name banner, just like persons. However, this is NOT a person.

4.name: Trader
4.text: {asterisk}Worth 25{fame} if your production of {tradeGood} is 10 or more.
4.helpText:
VERSION NOTE: This previously only required 8 [tradegoods] production.
Only resource icons on cards that are used for production are counted as production, not other effects that let you gain resources.
NOTE: Goals have the yellow name banner, just like persons. However, this is NOT a person.

description:
VERSION NOTE: Loyalty has become less worth (previously 35) and Trader has instead become harder to reach (10 production instead of 8).
This is a goal card which is worth fame [vp] depending on how well you do in certain areas. The red arrows at the top of this card means that when you discover it, you must choose which of its 2 sides should be face up (the serial number must be at the top of this card, whichever side you choose). Choose wisely, since you cannot change this later. Loyalty is worth more, but is a bit harder to control. Trader is safer and easier to accomplish, but gives less [vp].
